branded.why: An American chocolate drink since 1928, part of American popular culture.

about.text: A chocolate-flavoured drink created in 1928 in Garfield, New Jersey, and now made by Keurig Dr Pepper. As of 2019 its main ingredients were water, high-fructose corn syrup and whey, and its milk content was disputed in a 2010 lawsuit.
